note: The main banks were taken as Albania's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): BKT, Raiffeisen Bank and Credins Bank, with ABI Bank kept from the earlier reading. ABI Bank: its pre-contract information for its Visa Classic credit card (undated), read again 2026-10-30. It bears 18% a year on purchases and 24% on withdrawals, in lek or euros; the yearly card fee is 1,250 lek after a first year at 625, which is introductory and not written. The minimum payment is 7% of the amount used, at least 1,500 lek; a withdrawal at ABI's own ATMs costs 2.00%, at least 300 lek (2.25% and 2.50% at other banks, not written); a transaction in a foreign currency costs 1.00%. The unpaid part of a minimum not paid in full bears 30% a year, written as the penalty rate (with penalty and default interest together capped at 30% of the obligation, a cap not modelled). The 100-lek account maintenance in the example belongs to the linked current account and isn't written. BKT's credit card page shows its rates only in a section that didn't come up to a plain fetch, and Raiffeisen's answered with a captcha; Credins wasn't reached in this pass. None is written.

sources.title: ABI Bank, pre-contract information: Karte krediti Visa Classic
sources.said: KARTE KREDITI - VISA CLASSIC ... Pagesa minimale = 7% Min 1.500 Leke/ 15 Eur ... 18% ne blerje / ... 24% ne terheqje ... Tërheqje ne ATM-të e rrjetit te ABI Bank 2.00% Min 300 Lek/ 2Eur ... Komision për transaksione në monedhë të huaj 1.00% ... për vitin pasardhës: 1.250 Leke / 10 Eur ... pa asnjë lajmërim tjetër është në vonesë dhe mbi te do te aplikohet komision ne vlerën 30% vjetore.
